heroTitle: AI made in Saskatchewan: lessons from a homegrown success
heroSub: Saskatchewan has quietly produced world-class technology companies. We talk about building deep-tech on the Prairies, what it takes to compete globally, and what small businesses can learn from how serious R&D teams actually adopt new tools.
title: AI Made in Saskatchewan

chamberCta.text: Members of partner chambers get a member-rate AI Visibility Audit and a monthly white-label briefing.

guest.name: Jeff Dyck
guest.bio: Vice President of R&D at Siemens EDA and co-founder of Solido Design Automation, a Saskatoon-born company whose machine-learning tools became an industry standard before its acquisition by Siemens.
